children: ), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its first warehouse store and design center in Raleigh, North Carolina, located at 3131 Capital Blvd.
The Raleigh store opens with a team of approximately 50 associates and is led by Jackie Wint, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.

Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.

“Opening Floor & Decor’s first store in Raleigh is an exciting milestone for our team,” said Wint. “For more than 25 years, Floor & Decor has focused on making quality, trend-forward hard-surface flooring accessible to everyone, and we’re proud to bring that commitment to the Raleigh community. We look forward to serving our new customers and helping bring their ideas to life.”

Floor & Decor will open the doors of its new Raleigh store to customers on Thursday, October 15, 2026, ahead of the official grand opening celebration on Thursday, November 5, 2026, with a full day of events for homeowners and professionals.
Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Thursday, November 5, at 10 a.m. ET, in partnership with the Greater Raleigh Chamber of Commerce.

That evening, from 5 to 8 p.m. ET, the store will host a PRO Grand Opening Event for local contractors, installers, designers, and other trade professionals. Attendees will have the chance to win a 2026 Chevrolet Colorado.
Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET
For more information on the PRO Grand Opening events and resources, visit: www.prograndopening.com/raleighpro.

Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
